# Getting help with orcidtr

Start with a minimal reproducible example made with the [reprex](https://reprex.tidyverse.org/) package. It shows exactly what you ran and what came back, which is usually enough to see the problem.

Questions about how to use the package are best asked on [Posit Community](https://forum.posit.co/) or Stack Overflow with the `r` tag, where more people will see them. Bugs and feature requests go in the [issue tracker](https://github.com/lorenzoFabbri/orcidtr/issues/new). Search the [existing issues](https://github.com/lorenzoFabbri/orcidtr/issues?q=is%3Aissue) first, open and closed, in case the problem is already reported or fixed in the development version.

If the problem is with the ORCID API itself rather than the package, `orcidtr::orcid_ping()` tells you whether the API is up.
